title: Derivative of a Hermite exponential product
statement: For every nonnegative integer $k$ and complex numbers $x,z$, the function $w\mapsto H_k(x-w)\exp(xw-w^2/2)$ has derivative at $w=z$ equal to $H_{k+1}(x-z)\exp(xz-z^2/2)$, where $H_k$ denotes the $k$th Hermite polynomial.
